name: infra-s3-and-queue-fixture
description: Shared sample-app fixture for the object-storage-s3 (T-2), messaging-queue-cloudflare (T-3), and jobs-background (T-4) blueprints. T-2 side: boots MinIO via docker compose, exposes a facade over @aws-sdk/client-s3 against MinIO on http://localhost:9000, and hosts induced-failure switches the six shipped probes drive against. T-3 side: exposes an in-memory queue-driver realising the Cloudflare Queues binding shape (send / sendBatch on the producer side, batch envelope with ack / retry per message on the consumer side) alongside a wrangler.toml that declares the real Queues binding a live Workers project would receive; the five shipped T-3 probes drive the fixture facade against the in-memory driver, no live wrangler process required (per SDR-3-a on US-29107). T-4 side: extends with a jobs/ directory carrying two toy job-definition modules, a jobs-runtime that reads the applied queue and fires the four lifecycle events on the T-4-owned run-log sink, and an inProcess scheduler with a fake-clock seam; the five shipped T-4 probes drive the fixture jobs-runtime against the T-3 in-memory queue seam.
